partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Direct GOF-process suppression
results.hypothesis: A drug that decreases a compact process containing a gain-of-function disease driver may counter the overactive disease mechanism.
results.body: drug decreases CTD biological process containing Gene2Phenotype gain-of-function disease driver
results.mechanism_rationale: Drug-process direction opposes driver variant direction, but process membership does not prove that the entire process is overactive.
results.trapi_notes: The positive path and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; provenance, variant form, process degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[process_effect:AFFECTS]->
      (process:BiologicalProcess)
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)

WHERE process_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND process_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:ctd' IN
      coalesce(process_effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Cross-channel GOF-process suppression
results.hypothesis: GOF-process suppression is stronger when the drug also directly binds and decreases a distinct gene in the same compact process.
results.body: R255 plus directly bound distinct target decreased in the same process
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent CTD process perturbation and direct target perturbation converge with a gain-of-function disease driver.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph is TRAPI-expressible; repeated drug and process identity, provenance, variant form, direction, degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[process_effect:AFFECTS]->
      (process:BiologicalProcess)
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)

MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[target_effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)

WHERE process_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND process_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:ctd' IN
      coalesce(process_effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND target <> driver
  AND target_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND target_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND target_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
